junction.name: Eastern Avenue Northeast & Addison Road, Washington DC

claims.text: Eastern Avenue Northeast & Addison Road had 56 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 2 pedestrians injured, 0 cyclists injured and 0 people killed.
At the U.S. DOT's values that harm costs about $3.8 million a year.
34% of crashes here had only people in vehicles hurt, against 23% at the city's worst crash locations.
The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: not shown (at 267 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (-19%, 95% interval -35% to +1%) could be zero).
Pedestrian Hybrid Beacons would avoid about 0.2 crashes a year (CMF 10608, the record FHWA's fact sheet cites), worth $62,000 a year.
Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons would avoid about 0.2 crashes a year (CMF 9024, the record FHWA's fact sheet cites), worth $65,000 a year.
The District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is responsible for Addison Road, Eastern Avenue Northeast, Minnesota Avenue Northeast (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
A request letter to the District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is ready to draft from these facts.
